title: Explainable Hybrid Feature Selection for Intrusion Detection in Internet of Medical Things Environments
abstract: arXiv:2608.00869v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) networks are hard to protect: devices are heterogeneous, computing resources are scarce, and traffic must be analyzed in real time. We present an intrusion detection system that addresses these constraints through feature selection. A Pearson correlation filter first removes redundant attributes; a hybrid strategy then combines model-based feature importance with SHAP attribution to pick a compact subset, on which we train Random Forest and LightGBM classifiers. SHAP and LIME explain what each retained feature contributes to the decisions. On CIC-IoMT 2024 and CIC-IDS 2017, the method cuts the feature space by up to 88% - from 40 to as few as 5 features - and accuracy and F1-score stay within a few points of models trained on all features. Compact, interpretable detectors of this kind are practical candidates for deployment on resource-limited medical networks.

translated_title: 面向医疗物联网环境入侵检测的可解释混合特征选择方法
translated_abstract: 医疗物联网网络难以保护：设备异构、计算资源稀缺，且流量必须实时分析。我们提出了一种通过特征选择来应对这些约束的入侵检测系统。首先使用皮尔逊相关性过滤器去除冗余属性；随后采用混合策略将基于模型的特征重要性与SHAP归因相结合，筛选出紧凑的特征子集，并在此基础上训练随机森林和LightGBM分类器。SHAP和LIME用于解释每个保留特征对检测决策的贡献。在CIC-IoMT 2024和CIC-IDS 2017数据集上，该方法将特征空间削减高达88%——从40个特征减少到最少5个特征——而准确率和F1分数与使用全部特征训练的模型相比仅相差几个百分点。这种紧凑、可解释的检测器是在资源受限的医疗网络上部署的实用候选方案。
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合皮尔逊相关过滤、模型特征重要性与SHAP归因的可解释混合特征选择方法，用于医疗物联网入侵检测，可将特征数量削减高达88%（从40个减至5个），同时保持与全特征模型相近的准确率和F1分数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainable hybrid feature selection method combining Pearson correlation filtering, model-based feature importance, and SHAP attribution for intrusion detection in IoMT environments, reducing the feature space by up to 88% (from 40 to as few as 5 features) while keeping accuracy and F1-score within a few points of full-feature models.
